questions.prompt: You add a persona, three examples, and a new output format at once, and the output improves. What's the problem?

options.text: Nothing; more changes are always better
You can't tell which change helped, or whether one made something else worse
Personas and examples can't be used together
The model will reject prompts with too many changes

questions.explanation: Change one thing per round and rerun on the same inputs, so each effect has a known cause.

questions.prompt: Which inputs belong in a small prompt test set? Select all that apply.

options.text: An edge case with missing information
Only the single input the prompt already handles perfectly

questions.explanation: A varied set (typical, minimal, long, edge, rule-triggering) catches overfitting. Testing only on the input you tuned for hides failures.

questions.prompt: The pattern where the model suggests a better version of your question before answering is called the Question ____ pattern.
questions.explanation: Question Refinement surfaces the details that matter, which is especially useful when you're new to a topic.

questions.prompt: Match each symptom to the fix to try first.

pairs.right: Add audience, goal, and specific context
Give a template or example; reply with only...
Provide sources and allow 'not in the text'

questions.explanation: Diagnosing by symptom points to the missing ingredient: context, format, grounding, or example diversity.

questions.prompt: Put the refinement loop in order.

items.text: Run the prompt on several inputs
Keep or revert, and log what you learned
Compare outputs to what you wanted

questions.explanation: Run, compare, hypothesize, change one thing, then keep or revert and record the result.

questions.prompt: A prompt only works after you send the same four follow-up corrections each time. What should you do?

options.text: Keep sending the four corrections forever
Fold the corrections into the base prompt and test it fresh
Switch to a different chat app
Shorten the prompt to one word

questions.explanation: A reusable prompt should work on its own. Rewrite it to include what the follow-ups taught you, then retest in a new conversation.
